entities.summary: Andreas Englund is a Swedish professional ice hockey defenceman for the Milwaukee Admirals in the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract to the Nashville Predators of the National Hockey League (NHL). Englund was selected by the Ottawa Senators in the second round of the 2014 NHL Entry Draft.
